title: DashboardNumberItemDescriptor
description: A single number/KPI tile within a number container.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: `count` does not need aggregationProperty. `sum`, `average`, `min`, `max`, `percentFilled`, and `percentEmpty` should specify aggregationProperty. Use filter to scope the KPI, for example count only active records.

name.description: Unique identifier for this number item. Prefer kebab-case such as 'total-events'.

entityName.description: Entity this number item sources data from. Must match an entity descriptor or known reference entity.

aggregation.description: Aggregation used to compute the KPI value.

aggregationProperty.description: Property name for sum/average/min/max/percent aggregations. Omit for count.

color.description: Display color name (blue, green, red, purple, orange, indigo, amber, teal)

globalDateFilterProperty.description: Date/DateTime property used to apply dashboard global date filters. Defaults to CreationTime when omitted.

clickToSeeRecords.description: Allow users to click to see underlying records when supported by the runtime.
